slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 【脑袋存放处，非女强，玛丽苏颠文。
“蠢鱼，坐上来，腿张开，搂紧——敢松就砍了你。”
江盼吓得腿都软了，几乎是手脚并用地爬上哪吒的膝头，两条细白的腿下意识绷紧，却被他用膝盖一顶，被迫张得更开。
她慌忙抬手搂住他的脖子，指尖都在抖。
谁能信？就在五分钟前，她刚被这煞神第十次弄死！
脑袋落地的脆响、被混天绫勒断气的窒息、火尖枪刺穿胸口的灼痛……
十次不重样的死法，次次疼得她灵魂发颤。
她不就睡前骂了句《西游恶人录》的强制爱太疯批吗？
一睁眼，直接穿成了书里活不过三章的炮灰小红鲤——还是被哪吒亲手砍死的那个！
攻略恶人系统绑定！
【目标1：攻略恶人值100%的哪吒！
【任务1：活过今晚！
活？江盼快哭了。
她试过跪地求饶、装可怜卖萌，甚至想偷偷跑，结果每次都死得更快更惨。
直到第十次被哪吒捏碎喉咙，
江盼实在绷不住了，哭着在识海里破口大骂：【死系统，你没有母!老娘服了！
老娘不干了！
系统急了，终于甩出个大招：【宿主挺住！
给哪吒下了怪病——离你三丈就吐血，挨着才能活！
江盼一听，眼睛瞬间瞪大：【我靠？你是正经系统吗？】
系统正不正经另说，她突然想起穿进来的这本书好像不太正经——那是她在花市摸鱼看的，只看了三章（刚好到小红鲤死），可这书根本是本|肉|肉|文啊！
还是1vn，最后女主被全员恶人折腾成那样，死法都透着股荒唐。
她就是觉得太毁神明形象，吐槽了句“有病”
，结果真穿进来了？
还好，她不是那个被*死的女主。
她就看了开头，结局是刷书评知道的，中间的弯弯绕绕全不清楚。
正发怔，系统又催：【宿主，怪病已生效，任务重启。
务必从哪吒手里活过今晚！
下一秒，她在血泊里第十一次睁眼，正对上张精致得妖异的脸——面如敷粉，眉峰入鬓，唇若涂朱。
江盼咽了口唾沫，慌忙别开眼，心里直打鼓：哪吒帅是真帅，可狠也是真狠。
content_en:
[The place where the head is stored, not a strong woman, by Mary Sudden Man.
"Stupid fish, sit up, spread your legs, and hug me tightly—if you let go, I'll chop you."
Jiang Pan was so frightened that his legs went weak. He almost climbed onto Nezha's knees on both hands and feet. His two thin white legs subconsciously tightened, but he pushed them with his knees, forcing them to open wider.
She hurriedly raised her arms to hug his neck, her fingertips trembling.
Who can believe it? Just five minutes ago, she was killed by this evil god for the tenth time!
The crisp sound of the head falling to the ground, the suffocation caused by Hentian Lingle's death, the burning pain of the fire-pointed spear piercing the chest...
Ten different deaths, each time causing her soul to tremble with pain.
Didn't she just criticize the forced love in "Journey to the West" before going to bed?
As soon as he opened his eyes, he transformed into the cannon fodder little red carp in the book who couldn't survive three chapters - the same one who was hacked to death by Nezha himself!
【bite!
Strategy for the villain system binding!
[Goal 1: Capture Nezha, whose villain value is 100%!
[Task 1: Survive tonight!
live? Jiang Pan was about to cry.
She tried kneeling down to beg for mercy, pretending to be pitiful and cute, and even tried to run away secretly, but she died faster and more miserably every time.
Until Nezha crushed his throat for the tenth time,
Jiang Pan couldn't hold it any longer, so he cried and cursed in the sea of ​​consciousness: "Damn system, you have no mother! I'm convinced!"
I quit!
The system became anxious and finally launched a big move: [Host, hold on!
Nezha has a strange disease - he will vomit blood if he is only three feet away from you, and he can only survive if he is close to you!
When Jiang Pan heard this, his eyes widened instantly: [Holy shit? Are you a serious system? 】
Whether the system was serious or not was another matter, but she suddenly remembered that the book she had passed through seemed not very serious - she had read it while fishing in the flower market, and had only read three chapters (just before the death of the little red carp), but this book was basically a piece of meat!
It's still 1vn. In the end, the heroine was tortured by all the villains, and the way she died was ridiculous.
She just felt that it was too damaging to the image of the god, so she complained that she was "sick"
, and it actually came through?
Fortunately, she was not the heroine who was killed.
She just read the beginning. She knew the ending by reading book reviews, but she didn't know the twists and turns in the middle.
Just as he was stunned, the system reminded him again: [Host, the strange disease has taken effect, the mission is restarted.
You must survive tonight from Nezha!
The next second, she opened her eyes for the eleventh time in a pool of blood, and faced a face that was so exquisite that it looked like it was powdered, with eyebrows that fell into the temples and lips that looked like they were painted with red.
Jiang Pan swallowed and hurriedly looked away, his heart pounding: Nezha is really handsome, but he is also really ruthless.
